detailed_description:
The video is shot from a first-person perspective (POV) with a cinematic, continuous storytelling style set inside <Subject 6>, the illuminated traditional Chinese study with soft daylight filtering through the bamboo trees outside.

[Shot 1] The camera is fixed at eye level facing the center of <Subject 6> near the wooden tea table. <Subject 1> (S1), the red-gold-haired young man with long red tassel earrings and royal blue draped outfit, steps forward from beside the bamboo screen toward the viewer, lowering his crossed arms as he approaches. He stops close to the lens, tilts his head slightly, looks directly at the camera with sharp amber eyes, and speaks using the clear voice timbre and cadence referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] 终于等到你了，欢迎来到我们的茶室。</d> He smiles slightly, gestures with a flick of his golden bracer-adorned wrist, and steps gracefully to the left side of the frame.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, <Subject 2> (S2), the red-haired woman in the cream knit shirt, walks forward from behind the calligraphy desk into the center foreground. Holding a porcelain teacup with both hands, she looks brightly into the camera with a warm expression and speaks in the voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] 你好呀，快坐下尝尝刚泡好的新茶吧。</d> She nods warmly, takes a small sip, and steps to the right side of the frame.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, <Subject 3> (S3), the woman with the dark bun and white off-the-shoulder sweater, walks confidently forward toward the camera from the sunlit window background. She stops in front of the viewer, leans slightly forward with a playful smile, waving her hand close to the lens, and speaks in the same voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] 嗨！今天天气真好，很高兴见到你哦！</d> She turns slightly and gestures toward the rest of the room before moving aside.

[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, <Subject 4> (S4), the young woman with cat ears and blue hair highlights in the white t-shirt, playfully hops forward into the close-up shot facing the viewer. She touches one of her cat ears, winks at the camera, and speaks in the voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] 喵~ 终于轮到我打招呼啦，今天也要开心呀！</d> She makes a small paw-gesturing wave with her hand and steps back.

[Shot 5] At 00:12.000, <Subject 5> (S5), the woman with mauve-pink hair and glasses in the grey suit, adjusts her glasses with one hand while holding a blue notebook, stepping calmly into the center foreground. Looking elegantly into the camera with a gentle smile, she speaks in the refined voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] 你好，大家都等候多时了，请随我们来吧。</d> She gracefully bows her head slightly, extends her arm toward the tea table, and all five characters briefly align in the background looking toward the camera as the frame freezes at 00:15.000.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] 15 秒五镜正反打，场景是放学后的美术教室。夏小满和顾砚辞用三个中近景正反打镜头约定晚会节目分工，顾砚辞落键弹琴并响起没有说出口的一句画外音，最后切回夏小满侧脸近景心里犯花痴；全程所有镜头保持中近景，不给远景。

detailed_description:
Acting direction for the whole sequence: nobody stands idle or poses for the camera; every character stays occupied with some small piece of business; in every exchange one character acts while the other reacts, a beat late.
[Shot 1] 0–3.2s，画面为写实电影质感，暖金色夕阳从左侧大窗斜入。美术教室中近景侧机位：夏小满半身在画架前，顾砚辞的琴凳在画面右缘虚化入镜。夏小满转着画笔转过身，抬手指指顾砚辞又指指画板。夏小满用 <Audio 1> 的音色，语速轻快 (S1) says: <d>[中文]我画你，你弹琴，行吗？</d> 说完嘴唇合上。The camera holds nearly still with a barely perceptible drift, at a slow speed and a small amplitude.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.200，反打切至顾砚辞中近景：他坐在琴凳上抬眼看向画面左侧的夏小满，手指在琴盖上轻敲一下。顾砚辞用 <Audio 2> 的音色，声线低而平 (S2) says: <d>[中文]画好看点。</d> 说完双唇闭合。The camera holds completely still throughout the shot, with no drift.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.500，反打回夏小满中近景：她抱着胳膊，嘴角一歪，冲他挑了下眉。夏小满用 <Audio 1> 的音色，尾音上扬带笑 (S1) says: <d>[中文]你弹好听点。</d> 说完抿住嘴。The camera holds nearly still with a barely perceptible drift, at a slow speed and a small amplitude.

[Shot 4] At 00:08.000，切至顾砚辞弹琴中近景：他嘴角几乎察觉不到地松了一下，转回琴键，十指落下，一段慢速的钢琴旋律响起；他弹琴时目光越过琴键望向画架方向，嘴唇闭着没有出声。顾砚辞用 <Audio 2> 的音色 (S2) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[中文]这首曲子，只弹给一个人。</d> while his lips remain completely closed. The camera pushes in very slowly toward his profile, with a small amplitude at a steady speed.

[Shot 5] At 00:11.500，切回夏小满侧脸中近景：她转回画架捏起画笔，执笔的手顿住，耳根悄悄泛红，抬眼望向钢琴方向，嘴角轻轻弯起来，嘴唇闭着没有出声。夏小满用 <Audio 1> 的音色 (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover as her inner thoughts: <d>[中文]认真的样子，有点犯规啊。</d> while her lips remain completely closed. The camera pushes in slowly toward her eyes, with a small amplitude at a steady speed.
【本段尾帧】夏小满侧脸中近景望向钢琴方向嘴角带笑，心声刚落，顾砚辞在画外琴键上继续弹奏，琴声延续。
【下段切点】切至顾砚辞弹琴侧脸近景，主体由夏小满对调为顾砚辞，琴声跨段延续。
